stem:
Part A
Which statement describes an effect of the Thirteenth Amendment?

options.label: A
options.text: It provided equal protection for citizens.

options.label: B
options.text: It allowed forced labor as a judicial sentence applied by the courts.

options.label: C
options.text: It allowed formerly enslaved people to participate in government decisions.

options.label: D
options.text: It provided additional powers to the judicial branch of government.

visual_elements:
Section 1. Neither slavery nor involuntary servitude, except as a punishment for crime whereof the party shall have been duly convicted, shall exist within the United States, or any place subject to their jurisdiction.

Section 2. Congress shall have power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation.

—Thirteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution
notes: Only extracted Part A question as a single problem as requested.
